title: Dobi-SVD: Differentiable SVD for LLM Compression and Some New Perspectives

layout.note: Irregular mosaic inside one lilac frame: at the top, tiles 1 and 2 stacked on the left (about 42% of the width), the large landscape tile 3 in the middle and the narrow tall tile 4 at the right; one wide tile 5 spans the bottom, with a rank-ratio plot at its left and three sub-diagrams on a pale-green caption strip. Lilac dashed rules separate the tiles; no arrows join tiles.

lesson: Give each technique its own numbered tile with the picture that best explains it (a 3D plot, a formula that explodes then is fixed, a funnel, isometric blocks), and let the tinted frame, numbers and caption carry the order instead of arrows.
